{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm deduplication
print(f"After deduplication, number of rows: {deduplicated_data.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of unique patient_ids: {deduplicated_data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check severity distribution on deduplicated data
severity_counts = deduplicated_data['severity'].value_counts().sort_index()
print(f"\nSeverity distribution after deduplication:\n{severity_counts}")

# Compute fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = severity_counts['severe']
total_patients = len(deduplicated_data)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"\nSevere count: {severe_count}")
print(f"Total patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Fraction severe: {fraction_severe}")"}
